definitions.gloss: being absorbed, completely engrossed, in a trance
definitions.explanation: A state of being so focused or involved in something that one loses self-awareness.

examples.japanese: {無我夢中|むがむちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{走|はし}り{続|つづ}けた→走り続ける：22070_hashiritsuzukeru⟧。
examples.english: I kept running, completely absorbed in the moment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無我夢中|むがむちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいた→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: The children were playing, completely engrossed.

examples.japanese: {無我夢中|むがむちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I threw myself into work wholeheartedly.

notes:
A four-character idiom (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) describing a state of total absorption where one loses self-awareness.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{無我|むが}→無我：28976_muga⟧ (selflessness, no-self — a Buddhist concept) + ⟦{夢中|むちゅう}→夢中：03752_muchuu⟧ (absorbed, in a dream). Together: losing oneself completely in something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {無我夢中|むがむちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do something in a state of total absorption
- {無我夢中|むがむちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become completely engrossed
- {無我夢中|むがむちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧: to run in a frenzy (without thinking)

USAGE:
Often implies urgency or intensity — being so caught up in something that you act without conscious thought. Commonly used for running, working, playing, or fleeing.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{夢中|むちゅう}→夢中：03752_muchuu⟧: absorbed, engrossed (simpler, more common)
- ⟦{一心不乱|いっしんふらん}→一心不乱：05692_isshinfuran⟧: single-minded concentration (more deliberate, focused)
- ⟦{没頭|ぼっとう}する→没頭する：18376_bottousuru⟧: to be immersed in (more intellectual, sustained)
